capabilities.summary: Start OAuth login flow (primary auth)

params.name: provider
params.description: One of: google, github, twitter, discord.

params.name: redirect
params.description: Named redirect target after login (app = desktop, dashboard = website, admin = admin dashboard, cli = terminal). `cli` does not redirect: the callback renders a page showing a one-time login token for the user to paste into a terminal that cannot host the loopback listener (e.g. over SSH). The terminal exchanges it via POST /auth/login-token/consume. One of: app, dashboard, admin, cli.

params.name: redirect_uri
params.description: Redirect URI the callback returns to verbatim, with token/error/key appended, instead of the default openhuman:// deep link. Two shapes are accepted: an RFC 8252 loopback URI (e.g. http://127.0.0.1:53824/auth?state=...), or an https URI whose origin is a provisioned hosted OpenCompany tenant (e.g. https://acme.opencompany.ai/?company=acme). Anything else is a 400.

params.name: product
params.description: Product this login should be attributed to (tinyhumansai/backend#1214). Case-insensitive. Carried through the OAuth state and recorded on the user (sticky, additive) once the callback completes. Omit for no attribution. One of: OPENHUMAN, OPENCOMPANY, MEDULLA.
